notes: SMB customer, product-led. Fast decision timeline (wants POC in 2 weeks).
Primary use: customer support chat + knowledge base search. Start with hosted API then evaluate cost at scale.
Model selection questions are the main ask — they asked: 'Which model gives near-GPT quality without breaking the bank for 3-4M tokens/month?'
Their dev lead: wants to compare Llama 2 13B, Mistral-Instruct-7B, and Qwen-7B-small variants — tradeoffs: response quality vs token cost, latency on hosted tier, and safety moderation behavior.
Wants concrete sample prompts + token estimates for our pricing to show CFO. Cost sensitive but prioritizes response helpfulness for customers (fewer hallucinations).

Notes from SE: recommend starting with Mistral-instruct-like variant for instruction-following quality, but test Llama-13B quantized for tricky domain-specific answers; Qwen for lower-cost embedding/semantic search workloads.
They called out caching + prefix caching as key levers to control cost. Asked about tokenization differences between models and impact on billing.
Quote from CTO: 'We want something that feels as good as what we demoed with GPT-4 for critical flows but at half the cost if possible.'
Security: SOC2 required within 6 months, SSO for staff, audit logs must be retained 90 days. Data residency not strict; US cloud region OK.
Integration: building on Node.js backend, prefer SDK examples and small demo repo.
use_case_and_requirements: Workload: chat-first support agent + doc search embeddings. Expect 3-4M input+output tokens/month in initial POC window.
Latency target: p95 < 750ms for short turn (<=256 tokens); acceptable to have slower for long generative responses.
Throughput: concurrent sessions ~50 peak, bursty during business hours.
Quality target: reduce deflection failures by 30% vs current keyword bots; low hallucination on KB answers.
Model preferences: want comparison Llama-2 (13B) vs Mistral-Instruct (7B) vs Qwen-7B; open to quantized/variant recommendations.
Cost sensitivity: aiming to keep monthly inference bill < $10k for early growth; willing to trade minor quality drop for 2x cost improvements.
Routing/fallback: interested in using cheaper model for low-risk responses and higher-quality model for escalation/handoff.
Observability: need per-request token breakdown, latency, and error traces in console.
technical_questions_from_customer: How does tokenization differ between Llama/Mistral/Qwen and impact billing vs accuracy?
Are quantized variants available on Hosted API and what are the latency/cost tradeoffs?
Can we route a subset of traffic to a higher-quality model for critical intents? How to configure?
What's the recommended embedding model for semantic search balancing vector quality and price?
Any sample prompt engineering recipes for reducing hallucinations on KB answers?
recommended_playbook: 1) Provide side-by-side sample prompts and outputs for 3 models using the customer's KB (anonymized).
2) Share tokenized prompt+response length estimates and projected monthly cost at current volume.
3) Offer a 2-week free credits POC and a 30m technical Q&A to validate latency and quality.
4) Suggest initial routing policy: 80% cheap model for retrieval+short answers, 20% high-quality model for long or high-risk answers; enable logging for evals.
5) Include SSO setup notes and SOC2 checklist links to accelerate procurement.
